entries.mechanism: The Axiom/PolicyEngine leg applies Rhode Island's 2026 inflation-adjusted table and taxable-income base, while the pinned TAXSIM leg applies 2024 law. The exact residual is the indexation and law-vintage difference.

The Axiom leg evaluates the fixtures' completed Rhode Island taxable income, which deducts $350 (single) / $700 (married) more than PolicyEngine's 2026-projected standard deduction plus exemption ($10,900 + $5,200 single); the residual is exactly that gap at each case's bracket rates. Rhode Island's official 2026 indexed amounts are not yet reflected by either side. Actionable upstream: regenerate the rulespec-us companion fixtures via the encoder once official 2026 amounts publish; not fixable in this repo.
